notes.title: Cuyo Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Thank you, everyone, for your feedback. I will keep improving the game and making it a better experience.

 Added a death  animation and sound

 Fixed an animation problem where the pause menu was dark at the beginning of the scene

 Changed color of the pause menu buttons

 Added indication of the safe-side to the wall crawlers on levels 43 and 45

 Reduced brightness in some of the levels for better visibility

 The laser now has a visual indicator giving the player a heads up before turning on.

 Additional visual indicators for other enemies were added to help the player avoid unexpected damage

 Fixed an issue where the player couldn't wall jump to the opposite side

 Added the ability to look down if the level allows it. You can now press S on the keyboard or Down on the left stick to look down.

 The game modes have been renamed to Normal and Limited Jump. The reason is that I realized the relax mode was intended to be the primary mode. Giving the player a more relaxed experience. The limited jump mode is for those that want more of a challenge

 The Unlocks menu has been updated and displays the codes faster than before.

 The player's jump height has been slightly increased.

 Added icons to the level selection menu to indicate if the code has been unlocked for that level

 Added the ability to select the level above or below with a controller

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Made changes to the easy mode and made it a more relaxing experience.

 Extended controller support.
 Added different color themes.
 Changed the difficulty of some levels.
 Added more soundtracks.
